Video script:
A lady patient comes to the doctor for treatment. The doctor is about to give her an injection when suddenly the patient grabs the doctor's thigh tightly. The doctor cries out in pain. The nurse, seeing this, hits the patient on the head with a water bottle, causing her to faint. The doctor, in anger, forcefully administers the injection.
